title: Calls-only (voice + SMS, no data) prepaid packs at all four telcos: 28 days BSNL ₹172, Jio ₹177, Airtel ₹185, Vi ₹185; calendar month BSNL ₹190, Jio ₹197, Airtel/Vi ₹206; 30 days BSNL ₹184, Jio ₹196, Airtel/Vi ₹203; 84 days Jio ₹448, Airtel ₹469, Vi ₹470; Jio ₹147 for 22 days; year packs Airtel/Vi ₹1,849 (365 days), Jio ₹1,748 (336 days); 12 monthly packs = BSNL ₹2,280, Jio ₹2,364, Airtel/Vi ₹2,472 (idly arithmetic)

fact_sources.fact: BSNL calls-only packs: ₹172 for 28 days, ₹184 for 30 days, ₹190 for a calendar month; unlimited calls, 100 SMS a day, no data
Jio calls-only packs (TRAI Mandated Packs > Voice only plans): ₹147/22 days, ₹177/28 days, ₹196/30 days, ₹197/calendar month, each 300 SMS; ₹448/84 days with 1,000 SMS; no data
Airtel calls-only packs: ₹185/28 days, ₹203/30 days, ₹206/calendar month, 300 SMS in total; ₹469/84 days; launched October
Vi calls-only packs: ₹185/28 days, ₹203/30 days, ₹206/calendar month, 300 SMS in total; ₹470/84 days; launched October
The calendar-month pack renews on the same date each month
BSNL's packs arrived in November (reported 9 Nov)
TRAI, the telecom regulator, told operators to offer plans without data (voice-and-SMS-only packs)
Jio and Vi list these under 'TRAI Mandated Packs' on their websites
Per-day cost at 28 days (idly arithmetic): BSNL ₹172/28 = ₹6.14; Jio ₹177/28 = ₹6.32; Airtel and Vi ₹185/28 = ₹6.61
Year packs: Airtel and Vi ₹1,849 for 365 days; Jio ₹1,748 for 336 days (calls-only)
12 monthly calendar-month packs at today's prices (idly arithmetic): BSNL 12 x ₹190 = ₹2,280; Jio 12 x ₹197 = ₹2,364; Airtel/Vi 12 x ₹206 = ₹2,472
